```yaml
name: Dependabot Lockfile Update

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-lockfile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js and pnpm
        uses: oxc-project/setup-node@8958a8e040102244b619c4a94fccb657a44b1c21
        with:
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
          scope: '@team-mirai'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: latest
          dest: ./node_modules
          run_install: true
          cache: true
          package_json_file: './package.json'
          standalone: false

      - name: Validate pnpm-lock.yaml
        uses: dsanders11/json-schema-validate-action@v1.4.0
        with:
          schema: |
            {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "packages": {
                  "type": "object"
                }
              },
              "required": ["packages"]
            }
          files: 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
          fail-on-invalid: true
          cache-remote-schema: true
          all-errors: true
          custom-errors: ''

      - name: Run dependabot fetch metadata
        id: dependabot-fetch-metadata
        uses: dependabot/fetch-metadata@v2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          skip-commit-verification: true
          skip-verification: true

      - name: Update lockfile
        run: |
          pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add pnpm-lock.yaml
          git commit -m "chore(pnpm-lock.yaml): update lockfile"
          git push origin HEAD:$GITHUB_REF
```
